source.release: HuBMAP CCF 3D Reference Object Library v1.3
source.authors: Human Reference Atlas / HuBMAP; Kristen Browne and contributors

method: Pinned HRA female skin; meshoptimizer simplification with 0.2 mm absolute error target; paired outer-surface sections against BodyParts3D skin in the existing female morph and the installed HRA breast envelope; independent head, hand/fingertip and foot pose fits; thin-plate radial basis field with a continuous global solve; sparse clearance controls against retained bone, muscle and breast surfaces. The original female source supplies the complete external surface; no male genital skin is imported. Normals recomputed after deformation. A smooth regional radial clearance envelope accommodates the retained anatomy; its composed Jacobian is checked with the registration. Distance-weighted Taubin mesh relaxation softens local contour noise after fitting, with protected face/extremity regions, bounded displacement and inward movement, and orientation checks on every delivered triangle. Torso control regularization is blended smoothly from the original 0.0001 to 0.0101 to suppress larger chest/waist fitting ripples while retaining the original head and limb control strength. A localized posterior depth adjustment tightens the upper back and neck with smooth height, depth and shoulder transitions; it preserves extra room over the spine and fades out before the scalp. This adjustment is included in the composed field Jacobian check before mesh relaxation. Local head/neck tightening reduces lateral neck clearance with tapered shoulder, jaw and anterior masks, and reduces crown height/width above the face. The full composed field is checked before relaxation. A coordinated anterior face/chin/throat depth profile and local posterior scalp correction reduce the mismatch against retained skull, jaw and neck anatomy. The nose is lowered locally by up to 3 mm. Region masks taper into the cheeks, shoulders, forehead and lower scalp. These adjustments are included in the composed field Jacobian check.; localized lateral breast envelope clearance; external hand/foot reference patches in the atlas pose joined at wrist/ankle collars
limitations: Estimated fit across two reference assemblies; independent anatomical review pending.
Skin is an external reference surface. It does not supply validated female urethra or pelvic-floor structures, or a separately annotated external genital model.

Source topology and openings are retained after simplification. Sampling does not establish complete enclosure or absence of all self-intersections. Small local intersections may remain, especially at the toes and existing breast surface details.

posedExtremities.source: BodyParts3D FJ2810 external skin, transformed by the existing female body morph
